program.section_heading: Basic Industrial and Construction Skills Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion students will be able to safely execute technical skills in lab environments that are required for employment in the construction industry.
Upon successful completion students should be able to Investigate and resolve problems in construction planning, scheduling, and management.

Upon successful completion students should be able to demonstrate the ability to interpret architectural and construction drawings and documents, demonstrating knowledge of various building materials and methods and related building technologies

blocks.name: Core Courses-63 hours (Credits listed are in hours)

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space (CNSTB71AN, CNSTB71BN). These are the closed-list courses CNST B71AN and CNST B71BN.

The catalog prints the total as '63 - 0' and the courses as '27 - 0' and '36 - 0'. The block header states 'Credits listed are in hours', so these were read as 63, 27 and 36 hours. The trailing '- 0' was taken as a units placeholder, not as a range.
The block header line also shows '0' under Unit(s). The block's stated total of 63 was taken from 'Core Courses-63 hours'.
No careers are named in the program description. 'employment in the construction industry' appears only inside an outcome, so it was not recorded as a career.
